[Help and Legend](general-information-legend)

# ASPERGILLUS SPECIES

For localized disease (fungus ball), antifungal therapy is ineffective.

Consult Surgery and Pulmonary for cases of localized disease without systemic
infection. Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases.

# Duration of antimicrobial therapy

Treat invasive disease with intravenous antifungals initially, then
switch to oral antifungals for a total duration of therapy of 6-12
weeks dependent on the degree and duration of immunosuppression, site of disease
and evidence of disease improvement.

# Preferred intravenous therapy

[Voriconazole 6 mg/kg IV q12h for 2 doses, then 4 mg/kg IV q12h \($$$$\) R,H,](psjizid-voriconazole-6mg-kg-q12h-then-4mg-kg-iv-q12h)

# Alternative intravenous therapy for patients intolerant to voriconazole

[Amphotericin B Liposomal 3-5MG/KG IV q24h \($$$$\)R,O+ NS Hydratio](orz-set-abx-amphotericin-liposomal-fluid-flush-orders)

# Oral therapy after disease has stabilized

[Voriconazole 200 mg PO q12h \($$\) R,H,DI](psjzid-voriconazole-200mg-po-bid)
